name: adb-devices
description: List all Android devices and emulators currently connected via ADB. Use this to find the serial number you need to pass to android-logcat, adb-pid-of, adb-install, or adb-launch when more than one device is connected.

subcommand.name: devices
subcommand.description: Print the list of attached Android devices and emulators with their serials and state.

options.name: long
options.description: Show extended information (model, product, transport) for each device.

subcommand.install_instructions: Install ADB via Android Studio or: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.usage: Call this first when multiple devices are connected to find the serial for adb-pid-of, adb-install, adb-launch, or the android-logcat `serial` parameter.
